watches.name: HUI130
watches.description: Warming Vintage. Sure to satisfy the temptation when vintage is calling. The perfect beige hue melds wonderfully with the gold details. The highly polished surfaces harnessing every bit of light that happens upon them.

watches.name: HUI129
watches.description: A Snowy Frontier. One chilling view of this captivating timepiece is sure to shock the senses. Gaze upon the snowy mountain range taking place centre stage that blends seamlessly with the monochromatic housing for an ultra versatile everyday ready timepiece that is built to last and to impress.

watches.name: HUI128
watches.description: Bicolour Beauty. A simple magnificence of minimal tones of warm yellow gold and steel that blend together with supreme elegance. Easy on the eyes, textured and jagged to the touch, a true feast for the senses, and a dial so wonderfully crafted you can feel the texture with your eyes.

watches.name: HUI004-S
watches.description: Extreme determination in the pursuit of perfection. We tirelessly trawled and tested numerous combinations and designs before completing our HUI004-S. Another TIMELESS addition to our Huizen range. From the free flowing bracelet, ebbing and flowing and gently laying upon your wrist, highly adjustable and a beautiful accent of the bevels and sculptures of the case. The case bears precise, multifaceted brushing and polishing emphasising the sharp appearance of this dress dive watch. A precisely chosen ratio of case size to lug length was decided upon to accentuate the case design and allow excellent comfort and to match the curvature of your wrist. Finally, the most important component, protected under a crystal clear layer of sapphire, coated with an anti-reflective layer, shielding the tremendously crafted, vibrant sunburst dial that truly sets off this timepiece to a complete, other level while the elegant hour markers and handset were chosen specifically to fulfil the purpose of the neo-vintage.

watches.description: Your new dress watch, handcrafted to your specification, bearing a stunning high gloss enamel dial and highly polished roman numeral indices to elegantly match with polished and brushed case elements.

watches.name: HUI127
watches.description: Who Got You Shinin' Like That? A timepiece, blessed with the presence of a stunning, multifaceted white dial that effortlessly blends multiple textures, shapes and styles and adorned with highly polished gold indices. All set within a luxurious yellow gold case, exuding refined style and delivering exceptional performance.

watches.name: HUI126
watches.description: Day and Night. Versatility and Elegance courses through this beautiful custom watch. The masterfully brushed steel elements provide everyday wearability while the glistening, sharp rose gold facets prepare this custom creation for the dazzling nightlife. So capable you won't want to take it off.

watches.name: HUI125
watches.description: Deep Sea Dive. Diving with style, a stunning dress diver that doesn't need to sacrifice functionality to look this good. The dial ripples and radiates from the centre while a beating heart brings everything to life.

watches.name: HUI124
watches.description: Have To Have It. A famed salmon dial, a hallmark of every watch collection as a symbol of bold elegance bringing a unique warmth to an otherwise understated collage of colours. A salmon dial stands out as a conversation piece. This particular example features an integrated bracelet and minimal brushed and polished steel elements to not draw away from the stunning colour but durable enough to protect it.

watches.name: HUI123
watches.description: Sea Of Roses. When the land meets the sea, they present their best. A bed of blue sets the backdrop for the stunning rose gold accents that help complete the portrait. Constructed using a ceramic bezel and a substantial dome of sapphire, this is a custom timepiece that is sure to impress and will continue to look as good as new.

watches.name: HUI122
watches.description: Opening Hearts And Minds. Always coming back to the classics, the stunning shimmer of piano black is truly timeless and always desirable. A blend of wonderfully polished facets to break up the shimmers of deep black with some gold to tie it all together and step up the beauty even further.

watches.name: HUI121
watches.description: Modern Adventurer. A tapestry of beautiful details take centre stage in this stunning creation while the gold accents provide the perfect contrast to the subtle tones of grey. The varying textures and patterns are able to be used to maximum effect to create a dynamic tactile experience while worn, and you will want to wear it everywhere with its exceptionally comfortable rubber strap.

watches.name: HUI120
watches.description: Midnight Opulence. A striking timepiece where stealth meets opulence. Its matte black finish is contrasted by radiant gold accents, creating a bold statement piece for any wrist. Blending daring design with unparalleled craftsmanship, perfect for those who command attention. Powerful lume to aid you in the night, and supremely durable with sapphire crystal and its stainless steel construction.

watches.name: HUI119
watches.description: Vintage Style. A classic two tone colour combination in a simple, functional field watch enclosure. Boasting excellent visibility at the forefront, the splendid brushed facets are both durable and help to elevate to a classier status.

watches.name: HUI134
watches.description: Sleek, Sophisticated and Customisable

watches.name: HUI118
watches.description: Hearts On Fire. A beautiful warmth radiates from an open heart, sending waves across the dial that catch the light and meld it into a splendid array of earthy tones. A timepiece with a mix of colours that at first may seem uniform, suddenly takes on a multiplicity of forms the longer you grace your wrist with its presence.

watches.name: HUI117
watches.description: Keeping It Cool. A powerful ice blue dial puts on a chilling display that is sure to set pulses racing. The dial is blessed with so many details that a simple case pairing creates the perfect contrast for a highly functional timepiece that also allows you to keep track of two separate timezones.

watches.name: HUI003-S
watches.description: Superior craftsmanship meets supreme reliability. An opulent Arabic timepiece you can depend on when you need it most. The sunburst dial swaying and twinkling in the light putting on a mesmerising display and ensuring not one piece of its beauty is left to the imagination.
